notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.
